entities.summary: Charles Sutherland Elton was an English zoologist and animal ecologist. He is associated with the development of population and community ecology, including studies of invasive organisms. Charles Sutherland Elton was a naturalists & biologists from Liverpool (1900-03-29, Liverpool–1991-05-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
